title: Interactive Leaflet Maps and Shiny Apps with vantorr
text: vantorr package makes straightforward stream high-resolution Vantor / Maxar satellite imagery interactive leaflet web maps shiny applications, connecting map interactions directly R spatial workflows (sf, terra, stars). vignette covers: Authentication Browser Tile Streaming: Setting Vantor API key (VANTOR_API_KEY). Interactive leaflet Maps: Adding Vantor Vivid mosaics (WMTS / WMS), seamline overlays (WMS interactive WFS polygons), archive strips. Building Custom Shiny App: Writing custom Shiny app leaflet map inspects imagery vintage downloads GeoTIFFs current viewport. Using Drop-vantorr Shiny Modules: Embedding vantor_auth_ui() vantor_explorer_ui() Shiny dashboard just lines code.

title: Interactive Leaflet Maps and Shiny Apps with vantorr
text: Vantor Hub endpoints support two authentication mechanisms distinct scopes: OGC & Non-Administrative APIs (get_maxar_wms_basemap(), get_maxar_wms_tiles(), vantor_get_seamlines()): Work either API Key (maxar-api-key) OAuth2 Bearer Token (Authorization: Bearer ). Account Services / Admin APIs (vantor_get_usage()): Require OAuth2 Bearer Token (vantor_auth(username = "...", password = "...")), Vantor’s Admin APIs accept API keys. Browser-Based leaflet Tile Layers (add_vantor_basemap(), add_vantor_seamlines(mode = "wms"), add_vantor_imagery()): Require API Key (maxar_api_key URL query parameter), web browsers rendering tile requests attach custom HTTP Authorization: Bearer headers. use leaflet tile layers seamlessly, configure API key .Renviron (can also set VANTOR_USERNAME VANTOR_PASSWORD alongside use vantor_get_usage()): register start R session Shiny app:
code: # In your ~/.Renviron file: VANTOR_API_KEY="your_vantor_api_key" library(vantorr)  # Set a placeholder API key for demonstration vantor_auth(api_key = "example_api_key", verbose = FALSE)

what: Generating OGC WMTS Tile URL Templates
title: Interactive Leaflet Maps and Shiny Apps with vantorr
text: want raw OGC Web Map Tile Service (WMTS) URL template (EPSG:3857) use leaflet, mapgl, tmap, use vantor_wmts_url():
code: wmts_template <- vantor_wmts_url(product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30") wmts_template #> [1] "https://api.maxar.com/basemaps/v1/ogc/gwc/service/wmts?service=WMTS&request=GetTile&version=1.0.0&layer=Maxar:Imagery&tileMatrixSet=EPSG:3857&tileMatrix=EPSG:3857:{z}&tileCol={x}&tileRow={y}&format=image%2Fjpeg&cql_filter=productName%3D%27VIVID_STANDARD_30%27&maxar_api_key=example_api_key"

what: Adding Vantor Vivid Basemaps and Seamlines
title: Interactive Leaflet Maps and Shiny Apps with vantorr
text: add_vantor_basemap() (camelCase alias addVantorBasemap()) adds Vantor Vivid Mosaic imagery ("VIVID_STANDARD_30" 30 cm "VIVID_ADVANCED_15" 15 cm) leaflet leafletProxy widget. default uses pre-cached WMTS tiles (service = "WMTS") fast panning zooming, can optionally overlay seamlines (show_seamlines = TRUE):
code: library(leaflet)  map_widget <- leaflet() |>   setView(lng = -104.995, lat = 39.740, zoom = 15) |>   add_vantor_basemap(     product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",     service = "WMTS",     show_seamlines = TRUE,     group = "Vantor Vivid 30cm",     verbose = FALSE   ) |>   addLayersControl(     baseGroups = "Vantor Vivid 30cm",     overlayGroups = "Vantor Seamlines"   )

what: Inspecting Seamline Acquisition Dates via WFS (mode = "wfs")
title: Interactive Leaflet Maps and Shiny Apps with vantorr
text: survey fieldwork machine learning labeling, knowing exact acquisition date (acq_time), ground sample distance (gsd), sensor (sensor) mosaic strip critical. add_vantor_seamlines() supports two modes: mode = "wms" (default): Renders lightweight transparent raster cutline overlay across zoom levels. mode = "wfs": Queries Vantor OGC WFS endpoint via vantor_get_seamlines() given bbox adds interactive sf polygons clickable HTML metadata popups:
code: aoi <- sf::st_bbox(   c(xmin = -105.01, ymin = 39.73, xmax = -104.98, ymax = 39.75),   crs = sf::st_crs(4326) )  leaflet() |>   fitBounds(-105.01, 39.73, -104.98, 39.75) |>   add_vantor_basemap(product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30") |>   add_vantor_seamlines(     product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",     mode = "wfs",     bbox = aoi   )

text: stream individual archive strip catalog feature_id custom CQL filter (e.g., filtering acquisitionDate cloudCover), use add_vantor_imagery():
code: archive_map <- leaflet() |>   setView(lng = -104.995, lat = 39.740, zoom = 15) |>   add_vantor_imagery(     feature_id = "10300100EBEDF600",     group = "Archive Strip",     verbose = FALSE   )

what: 3. Building a Custom Shiny Application with a Leaflet Map
title: Interactive Leaflet Maps and Shiny Apps with vantorr
text: complete, minimal Shiny application built scratch using leaflet vantorr. allows user : Switch Vivid Standard (30 cm) Vivid Advanced (15 cm) basemaps. Toggle WMS Seamlines cutline overlay. Click Fetch WFS Seamlines load interactive sf seamline polygons current map viewport (input$map_bounds) display metadata table. Click Download Viewport GeoTIFF export visible map extent via get_maxar_wms_basemap().
code: library(shiny) library(leaflet) library(sf) library(vantorr)  # Ensure VANTOR_API_KEY is set in .Renviron or call vantor_auth(api_key = "...")  ui <- fluidPage(   titlePanel("Custom Vantor Leaflet + Shiny App"),   sidebarLayout(     sidebarPanel(       width = 4,       selectInput(         "product",         "Vivid Product:",         choices = c(           "Vivid Standard 30 cm" = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",           "Vivid Advanced 15 cm" = "VIVID_ADVANCED_15"         )       ),       checkboxInput("seamlines", "Show WMS Seamlines", value = FALSE),       actionButton(         "load_wfs",         "Fetch WFS Seamlines in View",         class = "btn-info btn-block"       ),       hr(),       numericInput("res", "Export Resolution (m):", value = 0.5, min = 0.15, max = 5, step = 0.15),       downloadButton("download_tif", "Download Viewport GeoTIFF", class = "btn-success btn-block"),       hr(),       h5("Seamline Vintage Summary"),       tableOutput("seamline_table")     ),     mainPanel(       width = 8,       leafletOutput("map", height = "600px")     )   ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   seamlines_rv <- reactiveVal(NULL)    # Helper reactive: convert Leaflet map bounds to an sf::bbox (EPSG:4326)   viewport_bbox <- reactive({     req(input$map_bounds)     b <- input$map_bounds     sf::st_bbox(       c(xmin = b$west, ymin = b$south, xmax = b$east, ymax = b$north),       crs = sf::st_crs(4326)     )   })    # 1. Initialize the Leaflet map   output$map <- renderLeaflet({     leaflet() |>       addTiles(group = "OpenStreetMap") |>       setView(lng = -104.995, lat = 39.740, zoom = 15) |>       add_vantor_basemap(         product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",         group = "Vantor Vivid",         verbose = FALSE       ) |>       addLayersControl(         baseGroups = c("Vantor Vivid", "OpenStreetMap"),         overlayGroups = c("Vantor Seamlines", "WFS Polygons"),         options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)       )   })    # 2. Update basemap and WMS seamlines via leafletProxy()   observe({     leafletProxy("map", session = session) |>       clearGroup("Vantor Vivid") |>       clearGroup("Vantor Seamlines") |>       add_vantor_basemap(         product = input$product,         group = "Vantor Vivid",         show_seamlines = input$seamlines,         verbose = FALSE       )   })    # 3. Query WFS vector seamlines for the current viewport on button click   observeEvent(input$load_wfs, {     bb <- viewport_bbox()     withProgress(message = "Fetching WFS seamlines...", value = 0.5, {       sl <- vantor_get_seamlines(bbox = bb, product = input$product)       seamlines_rv(sl)     })      if (!is.null(seamlines_rv()) && nrow(seamlines_rv()) > 0) {       leafletProxy("map", session = session) |>         clearGroup("WFS Polygons") |>         addPolygons(           data = seamlines_rv(),           group = "WFS Polygons",           color = "#00E5FF",           weight = 2,           fillOpacity = 0.15         )     }   })    # 4. Render summary table of seamline acquisition dates and sensors   output$seamline_table <- renderTable({     sl <- seamlines_rv()     req(sl)     df <- sf::st_drop_geometry(sl)     cols <- intersect(c("acq_time", "sensor", "gsd", "catid"), names(df))     head(df[, cols, drop = FALSE], 10)   })    # 5. Download GeoTIFF for the current map viewport   output$download_tif <- downloadHandler(     filename = function() {       paste0("vantor_viewport_", Sys.Date(), ".tif")     },     content = function(file) {       withProgress(message = "Downloading GeoTIFF...", value = 0.4, {         get_maxar_wms_basemap(           bbox = viewport_bbox(),           output_file = file,           resolution = input$res,           product = input$product,           return_type = "file"         )       })     }   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Interactive Leaflet Maps and Shiny Apps with vantorr
text: avoid writing boilerplate UI server code every application, vantorr provides two pre-built, namespace-safe Shiny modules: vantor_auth_ui(id) / vantor_auth_server(id): Manages API Key OAuth2 login, displays connection status badges, queries account credit usage via vantor_get_usage(), automatically refreshes OAuth2 tokens background via shiny::invalidateLater(). vantor_explorer_ui(id) / vantor_explorer_server(id): Provides complete interactive leaflet map, product/protocol switcher, WFS seamline date inspector HTML popups, live area (km2\text{km}^2) calculator, multi-tile GeoTIFF downloader (get_maxar_wms_tiles() progress bars). launch built-standalone demonstration app directly interactive R session single function call:
code: library(shiny) library(vantorr)  ui <- fluidPage(   titlePanel("Fieldwork AOI Selector"),   vantor_auth_ui("vantor_login"),   vantor_explorer_ui("vantor_map", height = "550px"),   verbatimTextOutput("selected_bbox") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   # 1. Authentication module (auto-refreshes OAuth2 tokens)   auth_state <- vantor_auth_server("vantor_login")    # 2. Explorer module (returns reactive bbox, seamlines, product, and resolution)   explorer <- vantor_explorer_server(     "vantor_map",     auth_reactive = auth_state   )    # 3. Use the reactive bounding box in your own downstream Shiny logic   output$selected_bbox <- renderPrint({     explorer$bbox()   }) }  shinyApp(ui, server) if (interactive()) {   run_vantor_demo_app() }

what: vantorr: Access Vantor and Maxar Satellite Imagery APIs in R
title: vantorr: Access Vantor and Maxar Satellite Imagery APIs in R
text: vantorr package provides R interface Maxar / Vantor Hub APIs, enabling programmatic access high-resolution satellite imagery (Vivid Mosaic basemaps, WorldView archives, analysis-ready data). natively integrates sf, terra, stars, leaflet, shiny.

title: vantorr: Access Vantor and Maxar Satellite Imagery APIs in R
text: Flexible Authentication: Session credential management via API Keys (maxar-api-key) OAuth 2.0 Bearer Tokens (vantor_auth()) automatic token caching refresh. Multi-Package Spatial Dispatch: Pass sf, terra (SpatRaster, SpatVector, SpatExtent), stars objects spatial query via vantor_as_bbox(), receive outputs GeoTIFF files, SpatRaster, stars objects. Basemaps, Tiling & Seamline Metadata: Download Vivid 30 cm / 15 cm GeoTIFFs (get_maxar_wms_basemap()), automatically tile mosaic large areas (get_maxar_wms_tiles()), retrieve vector seamline polygons acquisition dates sensor metadata via OGC WFS (vantor_get_seamlines()). Account Quota Monitoring: Query credit limits consumption breakdowns via Usage API v2 (vantor_get_usage()). Interactive leaflet & shiny Integration: Stream WMTS/WMS basemaps, seamlines, archive strips leaflet (add_vantor_basemap(), add_vantor_seamlines(), add_vantor_imagery()), embed drop-Shiny modules (vantor_auth_ui(), vantor_explorer_ui(), run_vantor_demo_app()).

code: # install.packages("devtools") devtools::install_github("michael-cw/vantorr", build_vignettes = TRUE)

title: vantorr: Access Vantor and Maxar Satellite Imagery APIs in R
text: Vantor API supports API Keys (long-lived, 180 days) OAuth 2.0 Bearer Tokens (session-based, automatic refresh). Note different Vantor API services accept different credential types: OGC & Non-Administrative APIs (get_maxar_wms_basemap(), get_maxar_wms_tiles(), vantor_get_seamlines()): Accept either API Key OAuth2 Bearer Token. Browser-Based leaflet Tile Layers (add_vantor_basemap(), add_vantor_seamlines(), add_vantor_imagery()): Require API Key (maxar_api_key). Account Services / Admin APIs (vantor_get_usage()): Require OAuth2 Bearer Token (username password), Vantor’s Admin APIs accept API keys. can configure credentials .Renviron file (VANTOR_API_KEY, VANTOR_USERNAME VANTOR_PASSWORD) set interactively R session vantor_auth():
code: library(vantorr)  # Option 1: Set an API Key for the session (for OGC & Leaflet functions) vantor_auth(api_key = "your_api_key")  # Option 2: Authenticate via OAuth2 (automatically caches and refreshes tokens; # required for Admin endpoints such as vantor_get_usage()) vantor_auth(username = "your_email@example.com", password = "your_password")  # Check account credit usage and quota (requires OAuth2 Bearer token & Admin permissions) usage <- vantor_get_usage(category = "PRODUCT", unit = "CREDIT")

title: vantorr: Access Vantor and Maxar Satellite Imagery APIs in R
text: vantorr accepts spatial objects sf, terra, stars (well numeric bounding boxes EPSG:4326 EPSG:3857) automatically transforms coordinates required projection. larger areas interest exceed single-request pixel limits, use get_maxar_wms_tiles() automatically grid, download, mosaic tiles:
code: library(vantorr) library(sf) library(terra)  # Define an Area of Interest (AOI) in WGS84 (EPSG:4326) aoi <- st_bbox(   c(xmin = -77.040, ymin = 38.888, xmax = -77.030, ymax = 38.892),   crs = st_crs(4326) )  # Retrieve a 30cm Vivid Basemap directly as a terra SpatRaster basemap_rast <- get_maxar_wms_basemap(   bbox = aoi,   resolution = 0.3,   product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",   return_type = "SpatRaster" )  terra::plotRGB(basemap_rast, r = 1, g = 2, b = 3, stretch = "lin")  # Fetch vector seamline polygons and acquisition timestamps (OGC WFS) seamlines_sf <- vantor_get_seamlines(bbox = aoi, product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30") large_mosaic <- get_maxar_wms_tiles(   bbox = aoi,   tile_size = 2500,   resolution = 0.3,   merge_tiles = TRUE,   return_type = "SpatRaster" )

title: Add a Vantor Vivid Mosaic Basemap to a Leaflet Map — add_vantor_basemap
text: map leaflet leaflet_proxy map widget object. product Character string. Vivid product name. Default "VIVID_STANDARD_30". Options include "VIVID_STANDARD_30" (30 cm) "VIVID_ADVANCED_15" (15 cm). service Character string. OGC service protocol: "WMTS" (default, fastest browser) "WMS". api_key Character string. Optional Vantor/Maxar API key. NULL, resolved session authentication (vantor_auth()) environment variables (VANTOR_API_KEY / MAXAR_API_KEY). group Character string. Name leaflet layer group. Default "Vantor Vivid". layerId Character string. Optional leaflet layer ID. show_seamlines Logical. TRUE, also overlays corresponding cutline/seamline layer via add_vantor_seamlines(). Default FALSE. cql_filter Character string. Optional custom CQL filter. shoreline_masking Logical. Apply shoreline masking (used service = "WMS"). Default FALSE. max_zoom Integer. Maximum zoom level tile layer. Default 21L. attribution Character string. Map attribution text. options list tile options passed leaflet::tileOptions() leaflet::WMSTileOptions(). verbose Logical. Print status messages. Default getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Automatically transformed target crs. token Character string. Optional OAuth2 bearer token get_maxar_token(). NULL, resolved via api_key, session cache (vantor_auth()), environment variables. output_file Character string. Path GeoTIFF file saved. One "CREDIT" (default), "FEATURE_COUNT", "REQUEST_COUNT", "MAP_VIEW", "GIGABYTE", "SQ_KM". token Character string. Optional OAuth2 bearer token (access_token get_maxar_token()). NULL, resolved active OAuth2 session cache VANTOR_USERNAME / VANTOR_PASSWORD environment variables. verbose Logical. Print summary messages. Default getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

title: Get Vantor Account Usage and Credit Overview — vantor_get_usage
text: list containing parsed usage overview response (including activations, usageCategories, tidy summary_df data frame available), NULL invisibly API request fails.

title: Get Vantor Account Usage and Credit Overview — vantor_get_usage
text: Authentication Requirement (OAuth2 Bearer Token ): Usage API (https://api.maxar.com/usage/v2/activation/overview) part Vantor Account Services (Admin API) (https://developers.maxar.com/docs/admin/guides/usage). Per Vantor API specification, API keys (maxar-api-key) accepted Admin APIs. must authenticate using OAuth2 Bearer Token via vantor_auth(username = "...", password = "...") (VANTOR_USERNAME VANTOR_PASSWORD .Renviron), account must Admin permissions view activation usage.

what: Construct a Vantor OGC WMTS Tile URL Template — vantor_wmts_url
title: Construct a Vantor OGC WMTS Tile URL Template — vantor_wmts_url
text: Generates OGC Web Map Tile Service (WMTS) URL template ({z}/{x}/{y}) streaming Vantor / Maxar Vivid Mosaic basemap tiles EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator) within leaflet, mapgl, tmap.

title: Construct a Vantor OGC WMTS Tile URL Template — vantor_wmts_url
code: vantor_wmts_url(   product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",   api_key = NULL,   format = "image/jpeg",   cql_filter = NULL,   verbose = FALSE )

title: Construct a Vantor OGC WMTS Tile URL Template — vantor_wmts_url
text: product Character string. Vivid product name. Default "VIVID_STANDARD_30". Options include "VIVID_STANDARD_30" "VIVID_ADVANCED_15". api_key Character string. Optional Vantor/Maxar API key. NULL, resolved vantor_auth() environment variables (VANTOR_API_KEY / MAXAR_API_KEY). format Character string. Tile image format. Default "image/jpeg". Options include "image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/vnd.jpeg-png". cql_filter Character string. Optional custom CQL filter. NULL, constructed automatically product. verbose Logical. Print confirmation message. Default FALSE.

title: Construct a Vantor OGC WMTS Tile URL Template — vantor_wmts_url
text: character string containing WMTS GetTile URL template {z}, {x}, {y} placeholders.

title: Construct a Vantor OGC WMTS Tile URL Template — vantor_wmts_url
code: url_template <- vantor_wmts_url(   product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",   api_key = "example_api_key" )

title: vantorr 0.2.0
text: Added vantor_wmts_url() generate OGC WMTS GetTile URL templates (EPSG:3857) leaflet, mapgl, tmap. Added add_vantor_basemap() (alias addVantorBasemap()) stream Vantor Vivid mosaics (VIVID_STANDARD_30, VIVID_ADVANCED_15) via WMTS WMS leaflet leafletProxy. Added add_vantor_seamlines() (alias addVantorSeamlines()) supporting transparent OGC WMS raster seamline overlays (mode = "wms") interactive OGC WFS vector polygons clickable metadata popups (mode = "wfs"). Added add_vantor_imagery() (alias addVantorImagery()) stream specific archive strips (feature_id custom cql_filter) via /streaming/v1/ogc/wms. Added vantor_get_seamlines() fetch basemap seamline polygons acquisition metadata (acq_time, gsd, sensor, ona, catid) sf object via OGC WFS. Added vantor_get_usage() query Account Services Usage API (v2/activation/overview, requiring OAuth2 Bearer Token authentication) account credit limits, remaining quota, consumption breakdowns. Added drop-Shiny modules vantor_auth_ui() / vantor_auth_server() (automatic periodic OAuth2 token refresh) vantor_explorer_ui() / vantor_explorer_server(), plus run_vantor_demo_app(). Added progress_callback argument get_maxar_wms_tiles() seamless integration shiny::incProgress(). Added vignette "Interactive Leaflet Maps Shiny Apps vantorr" (vignettes/shiny-leaflet-integration.Rmd). Added pkgdown companion website configuration (_pkgdown.yml) GitHub Actions deployment workflow (.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml).

title: vantorr 0.1.0
text: Added vantor_auth(), vantor_has_auth(), vantor_auth_clear() manage session credentials via OAuth2 Bearer tokens API keys (maxar-api-key), automatic fallback VANTOR_API_KEY, MAXAR_API_KEY, VANTOR_USERNAME, VANTOR_PASSWORD environment variables. Added automatic session token caching transparent refresh expiration. Updated create_maxar_request() support API keys Bearer tokens, custom user-agent headers, httr2::req_retry() transient HTTP errors (429, 500, 502, 503, 504). Added S3 generic vantor_as_bbox() supporting sf (sf, sfc, sfg, bbox), terra (SpatRaster, SpatVector, SpatExtent), stars (stars, stars_proxy), numeric bounding box vectors automatic CRS detection transformation. Added return_type support ("file", "SpatRaster", "stars", "stars_proxy") get_maxar_wms_basemap() get_maxar_wms_tiles(). Enabled modernized get_maxar_wms_tiles() using terra::sprc() terra::merge() multi-tile downloads. Added support EPSG:4326 EPSG:3857 output projections (automatically handling WMS 1.3.0 axis ordering) custom cql_filter queries get_maxar_wms_basemap(). Changed default file/directory output arguments get_maxar_wms_basemap() get_maxar_wms_tiles() use tempfile() functions never write user’s working directory default. Standardized messaging cli ensured graceful failure (returning invisible(NULL) informative message rather unhandled error) internet API resources unavailable. Updated DESCRIPTION metadata, Title, Description, URL, BugReports, Suggests fields pass R CMD check ---cran.
